title.narrative: Tuzla Canton Public Buildings Energy Efficiency

description.narrative: Sovereign loan of up to EUR 8 million to BiH which will be on-lent through a legislated cascade of sub-loans from BiH to the FBiH and then to Tuzla Canton to finance energy efficiency ("EE") measures in up to 173 public buildings in the Tuzla Canton (the "Project"). The loan will be complemented by EUR 2 million of investment grants from the European Union (the "EU") under the Regional Energy Efficiency Programme ("REEP"). The majority of the buildings are schools, including sports halls, and local health care institutions. The EE measures include thermal insulation of walls and roofs/ceiling as well as replacement of windows, energy sources and lighting. The Project will serve as a trigger investment under the Green Cities Framework 2 - Window II Extension 2 ("GrCF2 W2 E2"), initiating Tuzla Canton's participation in EBRD Green Cities. The Project will enable considerable primary energy savings and GHG emissions reduction from the heating and lighting of public buildings in the Canton. This will be made possible through EE renovations in up to 173 buildings and through a reduction in demand for fossil fuels as an energy source and the transition from heavily polluting sources (e.g. coal) to more sustainable energy sources (e.g. biomass). A significant improvement in the energy class, currently on average D, is also expected. The Project will also improve the Canton's procurement capacity and standards in line with international best practice. Finally, the Project will enable the development of a Green City Action Plan ("GCAP") for the Tuzla Canton, which will address the Canton's environmental priorities and challenges.
